test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'TABLE' is written as '2012125' and 'CHAIR' is written as '381918'. How will 'STAND' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

So, for the word TABLE and CHAIR, we have:

 'TABLE' is written as '2012125'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3580250231a68784a007b85a3a03ac615c725bf091849888329e4c3623bb59f.png] 

And,

 'CHAIR' is written as '381918'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4740e029af6e716c019c2f92db8cc2fd82b1a02dd5debcbd28914f1f29e61c8a.png] 

Similarly, 

'STAND' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cc0379c2b2b2ac805b701ab52744f6f76ac9c2847a2403f769228918f301ac9.png] 

Hence, the code language is **'19201144'** for the given word.
